component.name: OpenSearch Dashboards Desktop
component.summary: Desktop client for OpenSearch with GUI and TUI administration

description.p: OpenSearch Dashboards Desktop provides a desktop client for OpenSearch with unified cluster administration, GUI + TUI experience, and local-first storage.

ul.li: Connect to multiple local or remote OpenSearch and Elasticsearch clusters
Unified cluster administration and UI experience
Built-in terminal and interactive developer tools

description.p: Initial release of OpenSearch Dashboards Desktop.
